Instagram Analytics — Spring Quarter 2026

UCSB Rec Marketing

May 18, 2026

1 Executive Summary

Spring Quarter 2026 ran from April 6 – May 18, 2026 (data through end of quarter export). UCSB Recreation published 33 posts and 12 reels, achieving an average engagement rate of 4% on posts — up from 3.65% in Winter Quarter. No image-only posts were published this quarter; all content was either carousel (21 posts) or video (12 posts).

A new data source is available this quarter: daily Profile Growth & Discovery tracking, which captures follower counts, daily views, and daily reach — enabling trend analysis not possible with Winter data.

5 Key Takeaways

  • Engagement rate improved from Winter (3.65%) to Spring (3.98%) — a +0.33 percentage point increase.
  • Carousels remain the top-performing format with higher average engagement rates and reach than videos.
  • No image-only posts were published this quarter — a shift from Winter where 5 image posts were included.
  • Top post: “UCSB Women’s Rugby are NATIONAL CHAMPIONS! 🏆🏉💙 The team i…” with 10% engagement rate.
  • Top reel by views: “What? Vote YES for REC! ✅ ⁠ ⁠ 🗳️ YES: Recreation Programm…” with 12,381 views.
  • Best posting day: Saturday by average reach.
  • Follower growth: +89 followers over the quarter (1.0745^{4} → 1.0834^{4}).
  • Profile views: 668,675 total profile views across the quarter.
